ReasoningScratchPad: Investigating CPU spike patterns related to traffic surges and autoscaling behavior
Title: Container App CPU Spikes During Peak Hours
SystemDesignKnowledge: Azure Container Apps with horizontal pod autoscaling
InitialSymptoms: Alert triggered for high CPU usage, users reporting intermittent errors
SymptomsObserved: CPU spikes to 100% during peak traffic, autoscaling not keeping up, intermittent timeouts
StepsFollowed:
1. Reviewed autoscaling configuration
2. Adjusted min/max replica counts
3. Tuned CPU threshold triggers
4. Optimized container startup time
RootCause: Insufficient autoscaling configuration for traffic patterns
Pitfalls: Ensure autoscaling thresholds are set appropriately for workload
